stepTitle: A $$0.240\, \text{kg}$$ billiard ball that is moving at $$3.00\,\text{m/s}$$ strikes the bumper of a pool table and bounces straight back at $$2.40\,\text{m/s}$$ (80% of its original speed). The collision lasts $$0.0150\, \text{s}.$$ Calculate the average force exerted on the ball by the bumper (in $$\text{N})$$.
